tasks.title: Unify atomic file writes in persist.rs & export.rs
tasks.desc:
Prevent corrupted library or reader state on crash/power loss by replacing raw `fs::write` calls with temp-file + rename.
- [ ] One minimal atomic write helper used by all 6 writes in `persist.rs` and `export_markdown_to_file` in `export.rs`
- [ ] Unit tests confirm no leftover temp files and prior file stays intact on write failure
